grouping: Exact decoded pixels and pHash distance <=4 connected components; mixed-label components quarantined; original notebook groups excluded from training and evaluation.
limitations: Patient identities unavailable; similarity grouping does not establish patient independence.

No ground-truth tumour masks; classification does not validate the classical ROI.
Image-level experimental results; no clinical validation or guaranteed rejection of unrelated images.

training.svm: StandardScaler + balanced LinearSVC C=0.1; 3 group-fold sigmoid calibration on training only
training.mobilenet: Frozen ImageNet MobileNetV2 embeddings + balanced logistic regression C=0.1; no backbone fine-tuning
